provenance.checkpoint_policy: final trained policies; no fitting, selection or retraining
provenance.counterfactual_scope: same starting state, current inflows and daily limits; only the selected reservoir command changes, all other original commands held fixed
provenance.interpretation: Same-state restrictions do not prove global physical inevitability; same-day alternatives do not prove an improvement in long-horizon return. Alternatives for different reservoirs/days are evaluated separately, not combined.

classification_definitions.requirement_inactive: The effective service requirement is zero.
classification_definitions.no_violation: The executed service meets its requirement within reward tolerance.
classification_definitions.same_day_policy_alternative: Another available discrete command meets this service from the same saved state; future water value is unassessed.
classification_definitions.discrete_grid_gap: A continuous command meets the service but no configured discrete command does.
classification_definitions.same_state_capacity_limit: The service exceeds its optimistic outlet or turbine/installed capacity bound.
classification_definitions.same_state_water_limit: Releasable water above the current next-state storage floor cannot meet the service even at optimistic maximum head for power.
classification_definitions.same_state_dispatch_limit: The current feasible release ceiling cannot meet the service even at optimistic maximum head for power.
classification_definitions.same_state_head_limit: All continuous current-state power choices fail despite optimistic water, dispatch and hardware bounds.

definitions.violation_rate: violating active reservoir-days / active reservoir-days; undiscounted
definitions.mean_relative_shortfall_all_active_days: sum(shortfall / effective threshold) / active reservoir-days; undiscounted
definitions.conditional_severity: mean physical shortfall on violating days only
definitions.classification_fractions: classification count / actual violation count; no-violation/inactive rows excluded
definitions.daily_storage_position: (end storage - action-date lower bound) / (action-date upper - lower); not global active-storage fraction
definitions.alternatives: only violating states with a meeting discrete action; deltas refer to the minimum-meeting same-day candidate
definitions.same_state_residual_severity: sum of continuous minimum achievable deficits / sum of actual deficits in saved violating states; not a global lower bound across alternative earlier trajectories
definitions.accounting: repeated global/system/legacy scalars counted once on WDD row per day; mixed returns kept separately per reservoir
definitions.episode_year_fallback: explicit episode_year preferred; otherwise ordered first appearances of source calendar years per scenario
